Stochastic tracer particles whose statistics are tied to the **numerical flux** of the underlying finite-volume scheme, for passive scalars and related applications in **RAMSES** / **mini-RAMSES**.

**Published preprint:** [arXiv:2604.23041](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23041) — [@moseley2026arxiv].

When you add figure panels from the paper, place images under `assets/img/` and embed them here with Markdown `![]()`.
